gate_up_order: first half gate, second half up
alignment: standard PyTorch CUDA allocation; no additional alignment contract
stream_semantics: Python passes torch.cuda.current_stream(device).cuda_stream; adapter launches on that stream and never synchronizes
autograd: custom forward uses Episode 2 adapter; backward uses trusted analytical PyTorch derivative
fallback: controlled error for wrong device, dtype, noncontiguous tensor, odd width, or unsupported shape
